    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:

        if np.any(np.isnan(arr)) or np.any(np.isinf(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Input must be finite")

            raise ValueError("Input must be nonpositive (log probabilities)")

    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):

        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    # Compute weighted losses
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep_mask = margins >= tau_filter
